bullets.text: trimming a paragraph until only the question remains. the answers were just packing material.
duck at konomine-ji — the slope they call straight-up. the sacred spring still runs cold above aki.
overcast, mild. the sky has no notes today. the silence reads as approval.
a borrowed line asks where the flash of an image comes from. it never leaves a return address.
the picture arrives before you reach for it. asking where just locks the door it came through.
